author: jade-cho
title: GPU unit tests fail to extract OpenVINO package - tbb12.dll locked (Access denied) on Windows self-hosted runner
signature: remove item cannot remove item access to the path is denied unauthorizedaccessexception|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Extract OpenVINO packages step fails: Remove-Item cannot delete tbb12.dll, Access to the path is denied (UnauthorizedAccessException)

key_errors: Remove-Item : Cannot remove item C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll: Access to the path 'C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll' is denied. + FullyQualifiedErrorId : RemoveFileSystemItemUnAuthorizedAccess,Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.RemoveItemCommand
root_cause: Expand-Archive -Force attempts to delete the pre-existing install directory's tbb12.dll before re-extracting the package, but the file is still locked by another process (likely a lingering GPU test/runner process or AV scanner on the self-hosted Windows runner 'ov-dmz-35'), so Remove-Item throws UnauthorizedAccessException and the step fails with exit code 1. This is the 10th occurrence of this exact signature on self-hosted Windows GPU runners; the recurring lock is a runner/host-level hygiene issue, not a code defect introduced by this PR.
reproduction_steps: N/A - requires the specific self-hosted Windows GPU runner state (stale file handle on tbb12.dll under the shared install directory); not reproducible outside the affected runner.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'GPU unit tests' job; this signature is transient and usually clears on retry.

Investigate runner 'ov-dmz-35' (and other intel-gpu pool Windows runners) for processes holding a lock on install/runtime/3rdparty/tbb/bin/tbb12.dll between job runs (e.g., a lingering benchmark/test process, antivirus scan, or Windows Search indexer).

Consider cleaning the install directory on job start with a retry/backoff wrapper around Expand-Archive, or extracting to a fresh per-run directory instead of reusing/overwriting a persistent install path.
prevention_strategies: Add a short retry-with-backoff around Expand-Archive on Windows self-hosted runners, and/or ensure prior job steps fully terminate OpenVINO processes (e.g. test binaries linking tbb12.dll) and release file handles before cleanup starts. Periodically restart/recycle the affected self-hosted runners to clear stuck handles.
historical_context: Same signature recorded 9 times previously (2026-11-09 through 2026-11-10) across multiple unrelated PRs (#39653, #39617, #37406, #39577, #39668, #39034, #39444), always on self-hosted Windows GPU runners during the 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step. A rerun_search_string candidate for this signature was already verified in a prior run but has not yet been approved into errors_to_look_for.json.
